signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: The vendor may discontinue the product, which ends a lifetime deal.

evidence.quote: KillerPlayer.com reserves the right, in our sole discretion, at any time and from time to time to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, the Website (or any part thereof) and/or to add, delete or modify some or all of the Services, with or without notice.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage. 2 reviews say limits were reduced.

evidence.quote: We don’t want you to worry about bandwidth. That’s why each plan has a Views limit.
No matter for how long a viewer watch your videos (without refreshing a page); it will be treated as 1 View.
reduced the video quality and viewer count for the plan you promised would be unlimited.
have to be content with the quality of hd720 which is a relic because there are limits on higher qualities.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 8 reviews (3.5% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: It does not work, and support NEVER ANSWER the emails.
It doesn’t work, and there’s no support.
Sent in a support request 8/24 to support@killerplayer.com with no reply.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 3.25/5 vs 4.44/5 all-time (-1.19). 13% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 5.9 years old. Sold on AppSumo once before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $69 vs a stated $179 regular price (61% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime access lasts only as long as the vendor's website stays operational, not for the buyer's lifetime.

quote.text: The term “Lifetime Access” presents the period of time during which our website is operational.

finePrint.summary: Each plan has a Views limit instead of a bandwidth charge, which caps lifetime-deal usage.

quote.text: We don’t want you to worry about bandwidth. That’s why each plan has a Views limit.

finePrint.summary: One view counts as a viewer watching without refreshing the page, regardless of watch time.

quote.text: No matter for how long a viewer watch your videos (without refreshing a page); it will be treated as 1 View.

finePrint.summary: Starter is limited to 50 videos and 100,000 views per month, so it is not unlimited.

quote.text: Get Started 50 Videos 100,000 Views/Month No Video length limit No Bandwidth Limit Remove YouTube Logo

finePrint.summary: Buyers can get a full refund within 30 days of purchase if support cannot resolve the issue.

quote.text: Our support team are happy to help with any issues you have with our platform, but if there’s nothing we can do to help with your issues, we will issue you a full refund within 30 days of purchase.

finePrint.summary: No refund is available if the buyer fails to cancel within the 30-day money-back period.

quote.text: If you fail to cancel your Plan within the 30 days Money Back Period, no refund will be available to you.

finePrint.summary: Homepage promises an immediate full refund if dissatisfied during the first 30 days after purchase.

quote.text: If for whatever reason during the FIRST 30 days of your purchase, you are not satisfied for any reason with KillerPlayer, simply contact us and our support team will issue you an immediate and full refund.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can amend the user agreement at any time without direct notice by posting changes.

quote.text: YOU UNDERSTAND THAT KillerPlayer.com MAY AMEND THE USER AGREEMENT FROM TIME TO TIME WITHOUT NOTICE TO YOU BY POSTING THE CHANGES ON THIS PAGE.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can modify, discontinue, add or remove services at any time with or without notice.

quote.text: KillerPlayer.com reserves the right, in our sole discretion, at any time and from time to time to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, the Website (or any part thereof) and/or to add, delete or modify some or all of the Services, with or without notice.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can modify, cancel or limit the money-back offer at any time.

quote.text: KillerPlayer reserves the right to modify, cancel and/or limit the Money Back Period offer at any time.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can terminate passwords, website use, or features in its sole discretion with or without notice.

quote.text: KillerPlayer.com, in its sole discretion with or without notice to you, may (a) terminate your password and your use of this entire Website

finePrint.summary: Vendor can suspend or terminate accounts and refuse service for breach or unverifiable information.

quote.text: KillerPlayer.com may immediately issue a warning, temporarily or indefinitely suspend or terminate your account and refuse to provide Services to you if (a) you breach the User Agreement

finePrint.summary: When a subscription expires, embedded videos stop working until the buyer renews.

quote.text: When your subscription expires, all of your videos stop working. Your viewers can no longer watch them.

finePrint.summary: Plans advertise lifetime updates and 24/7 customer support as included benefits.

quote.text: Get Started Unlimited Videos Unlimited Views Everything in Premium Lifetime Updates 24/7 Customer Support

finePrint.summary: Monthly and yearly subscriptions will be charged at standard rates starting next month or year.

quote.text: Starting next month/year, all monthly and yearly subscriptions will be charged at the standard rates.
